title: Blue Light After Dark
paras: Mina works as a night guide in a fishing village. After a beach [[landing|landing]], her guests often stop in surprise: their wet footprints shine blue. It is not their [[imagination|imagination]]. Tiny living things in the seawater produce this light when waves, feet or swimming fish disturb them.

These tiny creatures are called dinoflagellates. In some conditions, millions gather near the surface. A sudden movement starts a chemical change inside their bodies, creating a brief flash. Scientists think this can help protect them: the flash may surprise a small animal trying to eat them, or attract a larger hunter. Even a passing [[tuna|tuna]] can leave a shining trail.

Mina checks the bay before each trip. Strong lights make the blue flashes harder to see, so she avoids the village's [[stylish|stylish]] beach café, where lamps cover the [[ceiling|ceiling]]. She also asks guests to switch off torches. This may sound [[unfriendly|unfriendly]], but darkness is essential. A [[national|national]] radio programme recently described her unusual work.

After the walk, guests return to a [[peaceful|peaceful]] room above the harbour for tea and [[relaxation|relaxation]]. Sometimes Mina's brother plays the [[flute|flute]] there. Yet the evening's strongest memory is usually the sea: water that looked ordinary by day has briefly revealed a hidden world of living light.
zh: 米娜在一个渔村做夜间向导。游客登上沙滩后，常常会惊讶地停下脚步：他们留下的湿脚印竟然闪着蓝光。这并不是他们的想象。海水中的微小生物受到海浪、脚步或游鱼的扰动时，就会发出这种光。
这些微小生物叫作甲藻。在某些条件下，数以百万计的甲藻会聚集在水面附近。突然的水流扰动会引发它们体内的化学变化，产生短暂的闪光。科学家认为，这可以帮助它们保护自己：闪光可能吓到正要吃它们的小动物，也可能引来更大的捕食者。即使只是一条金枪鱼游过，也能留下一道闪亮的痕迹。
每次出发前，米娜都会查看海湾的情况。强光会让蓝色闪光更难被看见，因此她会避开村里那家时髦的海滩咖啡馆，那里的天花板上装满了灯。她还会请游客关掉手电筒。这听起来可能不太友好，但黑暗是必不可少的。最近，一档全国性广播节目介绍了她这份不同寻常的工作。
散步结束后，游客们回到港口上方一间安静的房间，喝茶休息。有时，米娜的兄弟会在那里吹长笛。不过，这一晚最令人难忘的通常还是大海：白天看似普通的海水，曾短暂地展现出一个隐藏着的、充满生命之光的世界。

q.s: Movement in the water can cause tiny sea creatures to give off light.
q.why: 首段说明海浪、脚步或游鱼的扰动可引发光亮。

q.s: Mina chooses brightly lit places so guests can see the blue flashes more clearly.
q.why: 强光使蓝光更难看清，因此米娜避开灯光。

q.s: Mina's brother learned to play his instrument from their father.
q.why: 文章只说她的兄弟有时演奏，未提向谁学习。
